top_band: framed top opening with light-blue water surface at rows 8-12 (back dark rim row 8, light brown back frame row 9, water opening rows 10-11, front frame rim row 12)
evidence: Reading down a middle column: rows 8-12 form a clear 5-row foreshortened top surface consisting of a rectangular wooden frame (rows 8-9 back, row 12 front) enclosing a visible 2-row water surface (rows 10-11). Below row 12 is the vertical front glass face (rows 13-31, 19 rows) set back by 1px on each side under the overhanging top rim, with a bright water meniscus highlight at row 13.

style.evidence: The tank uses a pure black (#000) outer border along the sides and bottom (rows 13-31), and large flat fills of solid blue water (rows 14-19 and 20-26 have almost no variation across wide stretches), rudimentary 2-tone 4px seaweed, and repetitive 2-tone checker gravel. Wood frame has only 2-3 flat browns with no grain, looking much flatter and simpler than the Beodeul stall and well references.
